Build the diet tree from a prepared dataset, using the columns in its spec

Source: R/dv_metrics.R
dv_tree.Rd

The one way vignettes, the dashboard and the Shiny app build a tree, so that one spec always gives the same numbers. By default each record counts once (shares of prey records), even when the spec declares a count column; ask for currency = "numbers" to count individuals instead.

Usage

dv_tree(prep, currency = c("records", "numbers"))

Arguments

prep

A dietview_prep.

currency

"records" (each record counts once) or "numbers" (each record counts its count column; needs count in the spec). Records with an empty count, such as unidentified material, contribute 0 to the numbers currency, with a warning.

Value

A dietview_tree, as from dv_build_tree().

Examples

# the standard set-up: public ICES data, non-food items and nematodes dropped
phylum <- ices_lineage$phylum[match(ices_diet$prey_aphia_id, ices_lineage$prey_aphia_id)]
dat <- ices_diet[ices_diet$item_type != "non_food" & !phylum %in% "Nematoda", ]
spec <- dv_spec(
  predator       = "predator_common",
  predator_latin = "predator_latin",
  stomach        = "stomach_id",
  prey_id        = "prey_aphia_id",
  prey_name      = "prey_name",
  weight         = "prey_weight_g",
  count          = "prey_count",
  digestion      = "digestion_label",
  covariates     = c("region", "year", "quarter")
)
prep <- dv_prepare(dat, spec, taxonomy = "table", lineage = ices_lineage,
                   verbose = FALSE)
tree <- dv_tree(prep)                          # shares of prey records
dv_rank_table(tree, "Class")
